# Native save fixture

`stock-mgba-first-save.sav` is an ordinary first save from a disposable local
test game, created by stock mGBA 0.10.5 (Windows Qt). It includes the emulator's
16-byte RTC trailer. No bytes were patched or generated by the Rust validator.

ROM SHA-256: `8d599e9742e14c4418e754f9a105299d99058c584f59a7a1b5ae35eb8b336eb0`.
The linked `sSaveSlotLayout` has checksum sizes
`3892, 3968, 3968, 3968, 3968, 264, 3968, 3968, 3968, 3968, 3968, 3968, 3968, 3968, 2400`.

The fixture caught stale validator sizes at logical sectors 0, 4, and 5.
Its completed slot has save counter 1 and co-op generation 1. The native ROM
displayed its saved-game message, but the enclosing cloud checkpoint failed
because the old validator rejected this file. This fixture proves parsing;
it is not evidence of completed cloud checkpoint or resume acceptance.
